Scope of Work: The contractor shall provide one skilled and one semi-skilled person at each stations. 2. Deployment of Manpower: The contractor shall deploy a total of 05 skilled and 05 semi-skilled person, subj ect to the approved tender schedule. The personnel shall remain available at their respective stations and sh all perform duties as directed by the authorized Railway representative. 3. Qualification and Experience: Skilled personnel shall possess ITI/Diploma or other relevant technical quali fications in the appropriate trade, as specified in the tender. Semi-skilled personnel shall possess the minimu m educational qualification specified in the tender and shall be capable of assisting skilled personnel in maint enance activities. 4. Maintenance Activities: The deployed team shall assist Railway S&T staff in maintenance, upkeep and fail ure attention of Point Machines, Track Circuits, Signals, Axle Counters, cables, batteries, chargers, transforme rs, location boxes and other S&T equipment, as directed by the authorized Railway representative. 5. Safety Precautions: All work shall be carried out under the supervision and authorization of Railway official s. The contractor's personnel shall strictly follow applicable Railway safety rules, instructions and precautions while working near railway tracks, points, signals and other operational installations. No safety-critical operat ion shall be undertaken independently by the contractor's personnel. 6. Tools and Equipment: The contractor shall arrange, at its own cost, the necessary tools, tackles, personal protective equipment (PPE), uniforms and other items required for the work, except materials specifically agr eed to be supplied by the Railway under the contract. 7. Communication Facility: The contractor shall provide each team with a functioning mobile phone and ensu re effective communication with the concerned SSE/JE/S&T staff and the authorized Railway representative. C ontact details of deployed personnel shall be furnished before commencement of work. 8. Attendance and Supervision: The contractor shall maintain daily attendance and station-wise deployment records. These records shall be verified by the authorized Railway representative before certification of the monthly service performance and processing of bills. 9. Replacement of Personnel: In case of absence, resignation, leave or unsatisfactory performance of any de ployed person, the contractor shall arrange a suitable replacement within the period prescribed in the contra ct. Any applicable penalty for non-deployment or delayed replacement shall be imposed as per the approved GeM contract/SLA. 10. Minimum Wages and Statutory Payments: The contractor shall pay wages not less than the applicable minimum wages notified by the competent Government authority. EPF, ESI, bonus, leave wages and other st atutory benefits shall be paid wherever applicable. Documentary proof of wage payment and statutory remitt ances shall be submitted as required by the contract. 11. Bank Payment of Wages: Wages shall be paid directly into the bank accounts of the deployed personnel t hrough the prescribed banking channel. 12. Weekly Rest and Leave Relief: The contractor shall make its own arrangements for weekly rest, leave and other absences in accordance with applicable labour laws and the approved manpower requirement. No addi tional payment shall be admissible for such arrangements unless specifically provided in the contract. 13. Identity Cards and Verification: Before deployment, the contractor shall submit the list of personnel alon g with identity proof, address proof, qualification certificates and medical fitness documents, as required und er the contract. Police verification shall be furnished wherever stipulated. All personnel shall carry valid contr actor-issued identity cards while on Railway premises. 14. Uniform and Discipline: The contractor shall ensure that all deployed personnel wear the prescribed unifor m and identity badge, maintain proper discipline and comply with the instructions of authorized Railway offici als. Any personnel found unsuitable, negligent or guilty of misconduct shall be replaced as per the contract c onditions. 15. Emergency Duties: In the event of an S&T failure or emergency, the team shall assist Railway staff at the l ocations specified by the competent authority, subject to the scope of work and applicable safety procedures . Any movement beyond the specified stations shall be governed by the contract provisions and instructions of the competent authority. 16. Transportation and Accommodation: The contractor shall make its own arrangements for transportation,

accommodation, food and other facilities for its personnel. No free transport, accommodation or other person al facilities shall be provided by the Railway unless specifically provided in the contract. 17. Protection of Railway Property: The contractor shall be responsible for loss or damage to Railway propert y attributable to the negligence or misconduct of its personnel, subject to assessment and recovery in accor dance with the applicable contract conditions and rules. 18. Labour Law Compliance: The contractor shall comply with the applicable labour laws, statutory registratio ns, working-hour requirements, weekly rest provisions and other statutory obligations. The contractor shall b e responsible for its employees and for maintaining all prescribed employment and wage records. 19. No Employer-Employee Relationship: The personnel deployed by the contractor shall remain employees of the contractor. Their deployment shall not create any employer-employee relationship with Indian Railway s or confer any right to regular employment or absorption in Railway service. 20. Subletting: The contractor shall not assign or sublet the contract, wholly or partly, without prior written per mission wherever required under the applicable GCC and contract conditions. 21. Inspection and Performance Monitoring: The Railway administration may inspect attendance, deployme nt, tools, safety compliance and the quality of assistance provided by the contractor's personnel. Deficiencies shall be rectified within the time stipulated by the authorized Railway representative. 22. Payment of Bills: Payment shall be made in accordance with the GeM contract terms against satisfactory p erformance, certification by the authorized Railway representative and submission of prescribed bills, attend ance records, wage-payment proof and applicable statutory compliance documents. 23. Penalty for Deficiency: Penalties and recoveries for non-deployment, unauthorized absence, delayed repla cement, unsatisfactory performance or other contractual deficiencies shall be governed by the applicable Ge M SLA, GCC and approved tender conditions. 24. Applicable Conditions: These Special Conditions shall be read together with the approved GeM bid, scope of work, GCC for Services, applicable SLA and relevant Railway instructions. In case of inconsistency, the app licable contractual provisions and prevailing Railway/GeM rules shall govern. 25.
